thread:
maria_g: quick on-ramp sprint  finalize landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Deliverables: 1 hero line + 1 supporting sentence per mode, 3 launch posts, webinar hook. 20m cap.

jamie_growth: thinking of a framing that ties onboarding friction -> unit economics. hero theme: "On-ramp fast. Scale predictably." Variant A = cost-first, Variant B = compliance-first.

theo_prod: draft microcopy ideas: Hosted: "Get started instantly  pay as you go"; Dedicated: "Reserved throughput for steady pipelines"; Private: "Data sovereignty & on-prem options". Support lines will call out latency SLOs and predictable billing.

nina_design: CTA verbs: Hosted = Start, Dedicated = Reserve, Private = Request review. Private page UX: single-click "Request private review" that opens a prefilled modal; show a tiny trust strip: SLA, KMS, Audit Logs, Data Residency. I'll mock a hero GIF showing throughput scaling.

rory_growth: webinar angle: "Serving at Scale: economics and controls" with two hooks: cost-per-request and p95 latency. Promo plan: teaser (-4d), benchmark post (launch), webinar invite (+2d). Need one anonymized customer metric for credibility.

cs_bot: CS note (anonymized): "Customer moved to Dedicated and reduced p95 tail by ~33% during spikes." Will request permission to name them.

eng_webhooks: inbound routing proposal: collect mode_interest, company_size, target_arr_bucket, compliance_usecase. Routing rules: if company_size >= 500 OR target_arr_bucket == ">5M" OR compliance_usecase == "regulated" -> route to AE queue; else -> nurture. Sample payload for devs: 

```
POST /hooks/lead-capture
{
  "email": "...",
  "mode_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "company_size": "...",
  "target_arr_bucket": "<1M|1-5M|>5M",
  "compliance_usecase": "none|privacy-sensitive|regulated"
}
```

Return 200 on success; tag hubspot props. Also low-lift experiment: detect cloud provider from request headers and surface a dynamic CTA (demo vs signup).

legal_j: flag on public claims. Reword absolute statements and add footnote: "internal benchmarks on representative batch-heavy workloads; results vary by model and prompt mix." For customer callouts we need written opt-in.

jamie_growth: benchmark soundbite for socials (non-absolute): "In internal tests, Redwood cut serving spend by up to 3x on batch-heavy workloads while maintaining comparable p95 latency.*" add footnote link to methodology.

webinar-bot: Event created: "Serving at Scale: economics and controls" on 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. Registration: https://events.redwood.ai/serve-scale. Reminder: add partner co-host by Friday EOD for cross-promo. :calendar:

maria_g: timeline: copy freeze Tue COB, creative freeze Wed. I'll drop a short doc with hero options and A/B lines; please review by Tue morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
